question: Should CodexBar adopt the proposed universal quota-planning result as a supported cross-provider product surface, including its learned full-session headline and conservative fail-closed presentation?
rationale: The implementation follows an open design draft, but choosing the visible calculation, supported providers, and conservative no-estimate behavior is a product contract rather than a mechanical code decision.

options.title: Sponsor the proposed rollout
options.body: Approve the design contract and have the contributor finish presentation, validation, and real-provider proof on this branch.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Limit the first rollout to one provider or a smaller presentation scope while retaining reusable internal estimator work.

options.title: Pause implementation pending design review
options.body: Keep the draft open but defer further rollout work until the design PR receives explicit product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the proposed rollout
recommendation.body: Approve the design contract and have the contributor finish presentation, validation, and real-provider proof on this branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the linked design's reference to maintainer direction make this the most likely product decision route.
